# OneHand CRM

OneHand CRM is a CRM project in development.
The application currently includes account access, workspaces, configurable records and views, and support/contact forms. Feature availability is evolving.

Canonical public site: https://www.onehandsales.com/ko
Public locales: Korean, US English, Canadian English.

Public information:
- https://www.onehandsales.com/ko/about
- https://www.onehandsales.com/ko/contact
- https://www.onehandsales.com/ko/security
- https://www.onehandsales.com/ko/terms
- https://www.onehandsales.com/ko/privacy

Authenticated routes under /app require an account and are not public documentation.
Do not infer availability of OCR, AI assistants, integrations, billing, or complete sales workflows from planned product descriptions.

Contact: team@onehandsales.com
